newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet trade inactive, differentials steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet trade inactive, differentials steady.

text.p: NWE jet fuel business was inactive and differentials were notionally steady, traders said.
Outright values shed about $2.50 a tonne, with September IPE gas oil futures trading at $171.25 at 1615 GMT.
Demand was seen into the U.K. east coast, but with most of Europe taking the Ascension Day holiday little business was in prospect.
Cargo differentials were around September +$17 cif NWE, the level also talked on the barge market fob ARA. EU qualified material again was notionally $7 over fob Med high quotations.
